source: research/rick-style-spec/motion-library/ (project files); 70 strips from Rick #05 #08 #13 #21 #23 labelled by two independent measurers + 347 labels from #03 #04 #10 #12 #14 #22 #24

units.at: frames from the combo start (30 fps)
units.lean: degrees toward the combo side (+) or away (-)
units.ramp: [target, frames]: drawn steps one per frame

measured_rules.head_torso_same_frame: 9 of 10 inter-measurer pairs within 2 f (90 %), median 0 f
measured_rules.arm_head_window: 8 of 10 within 2 f (80 %); offsets -6..+5 f, either part may lead
measured_rules.legs_planted: legs moved in 5 of 63 usable strips (presence agreement 95 %)
measured_rules.leader: arm 38 / head 27 / simultaneous 17 / single part 35 calls; leader agreement 65 % [uncertain]

tilt_talk.desc: talking beat: head tilts and the torso leans the same way on the same frame, free arm opens palm-out within 1 f; legs planted

lean_reach.desc: reach for something: head turns toward it, body leans in 15-30 deg on the same frame, near arm reaches within 0-1 f; legs planted (knees bend only on deep leans)

laugh_lean_back.desc: big laugh: head tips back and the body leans back ~10 deg together, one hand to belly or hat; legs planted, a small bob

laugh_bob.desc: laughing bob: torso bobs on 3-frame beats, head rides with it, arms and legs hold

swing_down.desc: stamp/strike: arm already raised swings down in 2-4 drawn frames while the body leans into it ~15 deg on the same beat; head tilts at the hit; legs planted

toss.desc: lift then throw: hand lifts to shoulder, then flings out on the next beat; head tilts with the release; legs planted

point_out_tilt.desc: point at something: arm snaps out and the head tilts toward it on the same frame; torso and legs hold

turn_and_point.desc: head turns toward the target in steps, torso leans with the head on the same frame, the near arm points within 2-6 f (Rick #21 f1579->1585); legs planted

eureka_point_up.desc: idea: face snaps (smug), head tilts back and the body leans back ~10 deg on the same frame, one arm points up 2 f earlier or with it; legs planted

victory_up.desc: cheer: both arms dip for 2 f (anticipation) then shoot up; the body stretches up on the same frame; legs planted

dip_talk.desc: set down / concede: arm lowers, head tilts and the body dips on the same frame; legs planted

panic_clutch.desc: panic: both hands grab the head/neck on the same frame as a head tilt and side lean, then a shake every 2 f; legs planted

startle_dash.desc: startle then exit: head turns up/toward the threat in steps, then the body leans forward 25-30 deg, arms swing and the legs run (the only combo where legs lead the exit)

glance_shift.desc: nervous glance: look away and back while the weight shifts foot to foot (stride drawing for 4 f); arms hold

look_back_shrug.desc: look back over the shoulder, then shrug: the head steps round (front, 3/4, strong 3/4) and the WHOLE BODY follows: torso card to 3/4 on f2, feet turn on f3, torso to 3/4 back with the 3/4 back head on f5; holds looking behind; comes back round (torso 3/4, then front with feet planted forward) and shrugs with a head tilt
evidence: #22 f466-473 (front, 3/4, back with the torso following)
